required_operating_characteristics: The operating capability depends on a renewable customer contract base, distributed local delivery, and demonstrated service execution.
Winning and retaining work requires more than immediately purchasable fixed assets.
required_company_conditions: The analysis can define a continuing operating perimeter and ordinary-share claim scope.
The analysis can distinguish customer acquisition, service delivery capability, project startup funding, and other functional assets without counting an economic cost twice.
non_applicability_conditions: Use is not appropriate when the company is valued principally as a liquidation, development-project, regulated-financial, or pre-revenue project vehicle.
Do not present a complete company-level replacement range when the required operating capabilities cannot be separately bounded or their overlap cannot be resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the continuing customer contract base and the retention capability needed for that base to remain economically usable.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded customer relationship rebuild cost remains UNKNOWN and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only a company-specific evidence-bounded range for capability not already recognized by another component.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the rebuilding scope, evidence-bound range, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the regional operating organization, including the local management, staffing, operating systems, and ramp capability required to fulfil the customer base.
components.unknown_semantics: An unknown regional organization rebuild requirement remains UNKNOWN and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only the separately evidenced operating organization cost after excluding any customer acquisition or functional asset overlap.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when local coverage, staffing or system scope, ramp evidence, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the tender, referral, sales, and other customer-acquisition channels that provide a repeatable route to new work.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded channel rebuild cost remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only the channel capability that is distinct from the customer relationship rebuild component.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when channel scope, repeatability, evidence-bound range, recognition treatment, and relationship overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the qualifications, reference record, service execution record, and time-dependent credibility required to win and fulfil work.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded fulfilment record rebuild cost remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only the independently evidenced qualification and delivery capability that is not already included in customer relationships or organization buildout.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the qualification scope, delivery record, time to rebuild, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the project launch funding required before collections and settlements support an operating cohort.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded startup funding requirement remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize startup funding only once, after resolving whether the same economic need already belongs in balance-sheet working capital or EPV maintenance needs.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the cohort cash sequence, evidence-bound range, destination owner, and recognition treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Identify and rebuild any other separately evidenced functional asset necessary to provide the same continuing operating capability.
components.unknown_semantics: An identified but unbounded functional asset remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only a separately evidenced functional asset after excluding items already represented by another replacement component or the claims bridge.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the functional asset identity, operating necessity, evidence-bound range, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

completion_rule.company_level_range: A company-level ordinary-equity or per-share replacement range is available only when every required component is bounded and recognized, or explicitly excluded with a resolved value destination owner.
completion_rule.incomplete_scope: Any required component that remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY leaves the company-level replacement range incomplete and prohibits a joint protection price.
completion_rule.epv_cross_check: Compare with EPV only after economic entity, operating perimeter, ordinary-share claim scope, currency, unit, and as-of basis are comparable; never add or average the ranges.
completion_rule.joint_protection: A common protection conclusion is permitted only when complete replacement and comparable EPV ranges exist on the same basis; it is not permitted from partial components.
